data.title: Identifier Check
data.solution:
n = int(input())
for _ in range(n):
    txt = input()
    print("VALID" if txt.isidentifier() else "INVALID")
data.statement:

A valid identifier contains only lowercase letters ({{a-z}}), digits ({{0-9}}), and underscores ({{_}}). It must <<start with a letter or an underscore>> and <<cannot contain spaces>>.

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

Given n strings, determine whether each string s is a valid identifier.

A valid identifier contains only lowercase letters (a-z), digits (0-9), and underscores (_). It must start with a letter or an underscore and cannot contain spaces.
Input
Line 1: An integer n, the number of strings.
Next n lines: One string s per line.
Output
n lines: For each string s, in input order, print VALID if it is a valid identifier, otherwise print INVALID.
Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 20
1 ≤ length of s ≤ 100
Input characters: lowercase English letters, digits, spaces, and ASCII punctuation.
Example
Input
3
name
user_42
42user
Output
VALID
VALID
INVALID
